summary: Nomadar Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an acquisition of approximately 290,000 square meters of land in Spain for development of the JP Financial Arena. The filing provides no financial terms, price, premium, or deal structure. It is a routine disclosure of a completed asset purchase, not a special-situations event. No board recommendation, advisor, or material conditions are noted. The acquisition is described as completed, so no risk-arb angle exists.
